caption: The drawing depicts a circular mechanical object composed of a central large circle, surrounded by smaller circles, and several triangular and rectangular segments connecting them. The central circle contains concentric patterns, including smaller circles and decorative elements, rendered in grey, yellow, and red colors. Encircling the middle are alternating red and yellow semi-circular shapes. The outer ring features eight equally spaced, gear-like smaller circles, each filled with a starburst or floral pattern, and colored primarily in grey with red dots at the center. These smaller circles are connected by grey segments, some decorated with red triangles and dots, forming a symmetrical, radial layout. One segment at the bottom is attached to a rectangular mechanical component, shaded in grey, with additional detailing. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the object, which is composed of precise, clean lines and geometric shapes.
title: Cut Tin Candle Holder
